newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ATHLETICS-JUNIOR WORLD CHAMPION BANNED FOR DOPING.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-JUNIOR WORLD CHAMPION BANNED FOR DOPING.

text.p: Romania's world junior 400 metres champion Andreea Burlacu has been banned for two years after testing positive for the steroid nandrolone.

"Burlacu tested positive last year for nandrolone, subject to a four-year ban under International Amateur Athletic Federation rules, but has been suspended for only two years by our federation," said Romanian federation deputy secretary general Traian Badea.
"Under new Romanian sport rules introduced last November, the federation can impose a two-year ban for an initial offence, with subsequent offences subject to a life ban."
Badea said the federation had reduced suspensions of distance runner Petra Vaideanu and long jumper Marieta Ilcu from four to two years. Both tested positive for nandrolone.
Marathon runner Elena Murgoci had a life ban reduced to two years.
